description: This file is a Java unit test class for testing the functionality of the ImmutableJsonArray class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It contains various test methods verifying immutability, equality, hash code consistency, containment, addition of elements, iteration, string representation, index lookup, and internal cache strategies.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayTest
